facts.fact: The +Digit@l and Justisa pa Tudu Djintis projects, implemented by the Government of Guinea-Bissau and UNDP with EU funding, delivered a roughly 30-hour Word, Excel and PowerPoint course to justice and human rights sector professionals and other professionals, with a 36-hour trainer programme.
